name: discussion-preparation
description: Verify assigned readings, translate them completely into natural Chinese, explain academic English, and prepare source-grounded discussion analysis for Chinese international students.

interface.longDescription: Discussion Preparation helps Chinese international students work through assigned academic readings without replacing the source with a summary. It verifies the confirmed reading list, editions, page ranges, scan quality, and page continuity; produces complete natural-Chinese translations without omission or condensation; preserves useful English names and terms for source lookup; explains difficult academic English; and prepares source-grounded analytical notes after translation is complete. Users must provide materials they are authorized to use. The plugin contains no course readings, student work, remote tools, or data-collection service.
capabilities: Verify assigned readings and page coverage
Translate academic texts completely into natural Chinese
Explain difficult academic English and terminology
defaultPrompt: Verify my assigned readings and translate them completely into natural Chinese.
Explain difficult academic English in this reading without simplifying its argument.
Prepare Chinese-first discussion notes grounded in my completed translations.
